runs.text: Australia, judged like Israel. Ready? Official report. Finding one: Australia is stolen land. Aboriginal people lived here for at least sixty five thousand years. The British fleet arrived in seventeen eighty eight. Finding two: occupation. Australia claims forty two percent of Antarctica. That is three quarters the size of Australia itself. Finding three: in twenty twenty three, voters rejected an Indigenous Voice to Parliament. sixty percent said no. Finding four: in nineteen thirty two, the army brought machine guns against emus. The emus won. Finding five: spiders, snakes, jellyfish. Weapons of mass destruction. Sounds ridiculous? Israel hears it every day. Australia isn't an apartheid state. Neither is Israel, where one in five citizens is Arab. Both have real problems. One standard. So, one more time.
